series_label: Proportion of population using at least basic drinking water services (Nigeria, Total residence, Total wealth quintile, Drinking Water service type)
source_or_custodian: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (DATA_SOURCE attribute as returned by the server)
status_or_notes: Server returned 25 observations for 2000 to 2024. No observation was returned for 2025, so 2025 is not reported here. OBS_STATUS, OBS_CONF, OBS_FOOTNOTE and SERIES_FOOTNOTE were empty for this series. Values are shown rounded to two decimals; the server returned full-precision values. The total-residence series was selected by filtering RESIDENCE=_T, WEALTH_QUINTILE=_T and SERVICE_TYPE=WAT; the same flow also holds urban (U) and rural (R) series for this indicator, which were not used. The server flagged the unfiltered query as multiple series, so the total series was chosen on those filters. Flow WASH_HOUSEHOLDS was used because the recommended flow WASH_SCHOOLS was not checked for data; codelist membership is not data availability.
definition: Percentage of the population using an improved drinking water source, where collection time is not more than 30 minutes for a round trip including queuing (improved sources include: piped water; boreholes or tubewells; protected dug wells; protected springs; rainwater; and packaged or delivered water)
